prediction_text: Direction: Hillary Clinton wins the 2016 US presidential election (8 November 2016), per the conference forecasting panel's collective judgement. The panel majority, weighing the candidates' charts against the polling-favoured Democrat, lands on Clinton as the winner. Timing: decided on election day, 8 November 2016.
basis:
No tradition/system field appears on this card; the item is a western astrology conference panel forecast, decided by that genre's conventions.
Card facts used only: Clinton (Democrat) faces Trump (Republican) on 8 November 2016; most polls favour Clinton; an international astrology conference panel in Costa Mesa is forecasting the election. A panel forecast is a consensus artefact: where a panel of practitioners reads the same charts that the wider forecasting community read in 2016, the consensus of that season tracked the polling favourite and the conventional chart reading of the establishment candidate — the panel's collective call is therefore recorded as Clinton. This case is the panel/consensus item (contrast the following case in the same batch, which isolates one named panellist's divergent call; the two are kept separate and not merged). No individual chart data is given on the card and none is fabricated; confidence is held below mid-range because a consensus call carries no single strong configuration on the card. R80-REV1: binary winner only, no magnitude claim, not applicable.
